info.description: Transforms RFP Section L/M oral presentation instructions, PWS scope, and Key Personnel profiles into a slide-by-slide Shipley Oral Presentation Deck Blueprint with verbatim speaker scripts, a step-by-step Live Technical Demonstration Runbook with offline failover contingencies, and an adversarial SSEB Murder-Board Q&A prep bank.

post.description: Builds a slide-by-slide Shipley Oral Presentation Deck Blueprint, Live Tech-Demo Runbook, and adversarial SSEB Murder-Board Q&A bank.

example.rfp_oral_instructions_and_sow_text: SOLICITATION 47QFCA-26-R-0088 (GSA FEDSIM / DoD Zero-Trust Cloud & AI SOC Modernization): Section L.8 Oral Presentation & Live Technical Demonstration Instructions: Offerors invited to Phase II Orals shall conduct a 90-minute interactive session before the Technical Evaluation Board (TEB): (1) 45-Minute Oral Technical & Management Presentation delivered solely by proposed Key Personnel (Program Manager, Principal Zero-Trust Cloud Architect, Lead AI/SOAR Engineer; no corporate BD executives permitted to speak); maximum 15 slides. (2) 20-Minute Live Technical Demonstration in an AWS GovCloud IL5 sandbox showing automated SIEM alert triage, MITRE ATT&CK correlation, and zero-downtime Kubernetes container quarantine. (3) 25-Minute On-the-Spot Murder-Board Q&A following a 15-minute caucus. Section M.2 Evaluation Factors: Technical Approach & Live Demo (Factor 1, Most Important), Key Personnel Mastery & Oral Communication (Factor 2), and 30-Day Transition-In Risk Mitigation (Factor 3).
example.bidder_solution_and_key_personnel_contex: Key Personnel: (1) Sarah Jenkins, PMP/CISSP (Program Manager, 14 yrs DoD FEDSIM PM experience, led 18-day zero-outage transition on USAF AOC); (2) Dr. Marcus Vance, AWS Pro / CISSP-ISSAP (Principal Zero-Trust Architect, designed DISA IL5 landing zones across 42,000 endpoints); (3) Elena Rostova, CISM / CKS (Lead AI/SOAR Engineer, built automated Splunk/CrowdStrike SOAR playbooks reducing MTTR from 42 mins to 3.4 mins). Solution Discriminators: Pre-accredited Infrastructure-as-Code (Terraform) FedRAMP High / DoD IL5 landing zone templates; 98.7% incumbent staff retention track record; live fallback local container replay if government conference room Wi-Fi blocks GovCloud VPN.
